trello.name: Fix staging deploy job registry token
trello.desc: Staging is broken because the deploy job cannot pull the base image due to an expired registry token. Owner: Ade. Deadline: Within an hour. Steps: Regenerate the registry token, update the CI secret, and re-run the deploy job. Acceptance Criteria: The staging deploy job succeeds and the team is able to test.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing
trello.desc: Send the updated proposal to Meridian with the new pricing. Owner: Ade. Deadline: End of day today. Steps: Take the final numbers from the spreadsheet, drop them into the proposal doc, and send it to their procurement contact Lena (email found in the kickoff thread). Acceptance Criteria: Lena receives the updated proposal document with the final pricing by end of day.
